{{Infobox auto|type=Tool|renewable=Yes}}
'''Tinder''' is a single-use fire-lighting tool made from sticks and grass. It works like a [[Fire Starter]] (the renamed flint and steel) but breaks after one use, which makes it a cheap way to light fires before the player has iron.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe accepts short grass, a fern or a bush, and is unlocked by picking up a stick.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/tinder.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/stick.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
Tinder is a flint and steel with a durability of 1, so it can light one fire, [[Kindling]] or other block before it breaks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/tinder.json}}</ref>
